features: Capture sharp and detailed footage with the Godrej EVE Pro Wi-Fi Mini-PT Camera featuring 3MP resolution for reliable indoor security and everyday surveillance.
Easily connect the camera through Wi-Fi and monitor your home or office remotely using the Godrej Secure Hub app for convenient real-time access.
The Mini-PT design offers wider viewing coverage with pan and tilt movement, while cruise support helps monitor larger indoor spaces more efficiently.
Store recordings locally with the built-in SD card slot that supports storage expansion up to 256GB for secure and continuous footage backup.
Stay alert with smart human tracking and motion tracking features that automatically detect and follow movement for improved security monitoring.
